A '''Brewmaster''' was someone responsible for brewing [[Lomin ale]] at a Lomin-ale brewery. It was similar to a [[Vratix/Legends|Vratix]] [[Verachen]] but without the Verachen's highly defined rights and responsibilities within their society.<ref name="BW">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>
